Ninja Warrior Fitbit Sponsor Bumper

Proud to be working with ITV and Ninja Warrior UK in 2022

‹›

The male voice of the Ninja Warrior Sponsor Bumbers

Kammy Chris Kamara regularly uses my studio for voiceover work and he invited us to go see Ninja Warrior UK being recorded in Manchester. So much fun!
A week later an audition t voice the sponsor bumpers for ITV. Using my Commentator voice I nailed the audition and got the gig. These turned out great and I love being part of the show.
My daughter loves the Ninja Warrior Activity Venues too.

Ninja Warrior UK 2022

Race for Glory! After three years off our telly, Ninja Warrior UK is back for a new season as the new line-up of contestants take on an ultimate physical challenge. Returning, Ben Shephard, Chris Kamara and Rochelle Humes host the ITV gameshow, which has undergone a complete make-over during its absence – with the show looking for a male and female champion that can beat Mount Midoriyama. The contestants have to beat the course, and this year take on Elite Ninjas in a one-on-one race in order to make it through to the next round.

Where can I get a commentator voiceover?

I voice so much with my Commentators voice. Football, Golf, Cricket, whatever your production I'll add that extra energy with a commentary voiceover to suit. Shoot over the details and usage and let crack on with it!
